## Description

Constructs cointegrated statistical arbitrage spread trading bounds by optimizing trading thresholds over an ambiguity set defined by the Wasserstein distance around empirical joint distributions.

## Where it may fit

High parameter uncertainty, structural break periods in cointegrated asset pairs.

## Vehicles

Statistical arbitrage funds, quantitative market neutral equity desks.

## Required data

Intraday and daily closing price series for cointegrated asset pairs, historical volatility tensors.

## Caveats

Convex optimization reformulations can be slow for large asset universe pairs.
